title: Beyond the Impression: What Cint Brand Lift Data Reveals About Campaigns on Magnite
summary: Discover what Cint's brand lift data reveals about ad recall, brand awareness and consideration across premium programmatic advertising.
body_markdown:
> These findings reinforce that campaign effectiveness is about more than simply reaching an audience. The quality of the media environment, how often consumers encounter a message and the overall advertising experience all have a role to play in building meaningful brand outcomes. By working closely with partners like Cint to better understand that impact, we can help advertisers turn those insights into smarter decisions around supply, frequency and campaign strategy.


Kristen Williams


SVP of Strategic Partnerships


Magnite
